$comment: CANONICAL generator stable-name manifest (ADR-0021 D3). The single cross-port source of truth for generator stable names. Every port's generator registry is conformance-tested against this file: (1) every generator a port exposes MUST use a name listed here; (2) for each generator, the `ports` array lists exactly the ports expected to expose it (presence is checked both ways); (3) because all ports validate against this one file, a shared concept (e.g. `routes`) is spelled identically everywhere. Port ids: typescript, csharp, java, kotlin, python. `tier`: native (idiomatic per-port code) or neutral (Tier-2, owned by `meta docs`). Adding/renaming a generator = edit THIS file + the port registry together; the conformance gate fails otherwise.

entity.concept: Per-entity model/class — the entity module (table-backed or value object).

routes.concept: Per-entity REST endpoint surface (controllers / routes / router).

extractor.concept: Per-template strict typed extract<Name> helper (strict payload extraction).

template.concept: Generic Mustache template primitive (walk + template -> files).

payload.concept: Per-template payload value object (the strict payload type).

callable.concept: Per-entity callable wrapper for a callable source (storedProc / tableFunction); in TS it also covers the service surface wrapping the query helpers.

barrel.concept: Single index module re-exporting every generated entity module.

prompt-render.concept: Per-template prompt-render helper over the render engine.

api-docs.concept: Per-entity/template SDK API reference (generated-code API; human + agent forms).

trace-helper.concept: Per-entity typed record<Entity>/call<Entity> trace helpers (extract + buildLlmCallRow + persist; LlmCallBase-derived entities only).

db-context.concept: Single EF Core DbContext binding every generated entity.

spring-config.concept: Spring wiring/configuration for the generated surface.

docs.concept: Neutral per-entity / per-template Markdown documentation pages.
docs.note: Owned by `meta docs` (the single docs door, ADR-0021 D1); not part of the recommended native suite.

mermaid-er.concept: Neutral Mermaid ER diagram of the entity/relationship model.
mermaid-er.note: Neutral artifact owned by the docs engine (ADR-0020); surfaced via `meta docs`.
